what: Author states they have "personally written and sold ebooks on Gumroad" and names ChatGPT, Jasper, and Writesonic as AI writing tools used in ebook creation, describing AI tools as "a total game-changer for speeding up product creation."

notes: Member-only story; only introduction visible past paywall.
